title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 21 | The Crystal Cave | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
Echoes and glittering crystals deep in a cave lead the party to Niko the Enchanter. Niko joins, enchants everyone's weapons, and together they calm the shiny Crystal Golem before a sparkly night by the campfire.

0:00 Into the Glittering Cave
0:45 Niko the Enchanter
1:30 The Crystal Golem
2:15 A Sparkly Night

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
